proposal.summary: A hardcoded password was set for accounts registered via an OmniAuth provider in specified GitLab CE/EE versions, allowing login to affected new accounts using a known password.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab CE/EE versions 14.7 prior to 14.7.7, 14.8 prior to 14.8.5, and 14.9 prior to 14.9.2
proposal.cwe_quote: A hardcoded password was set for accounts registered using an OmniAuth provider (e.g. OAuth, LDAP, SAML) in GitLab CE/EE versions 14.7 prior to 14.7.7, 14.8 prior to 14.8.5, and 14.9 prior to 14.9.2 allowing attackers to potentially take over accounts.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Notify GitLab maintainers/PSIRT, verify whether any accounts on affected installations were created via OmniAuth during the vulnerable window, and advise immediate rotation/disablement of affected accounts and upgrade to a patched GitLab version.
